name: Ann Blair Thornton
why: Sharp, well-lit, smiling frame; she is the only named subject and the only face turned to the camera, wearing the Miss Kentucky crown and sash the caption describes. Cropped from a 1501x992 Herald photograph. NOTE FOR THE EDITOR: the archive already publishes a smaller crop (270x450) of this same photograph as 2009-10-ann-blair-thornton.jpg. years.json carries 'Ann Blair Thornton' (2008-09, member) and 'Ann-Blair Thornton' (2009-10, Secretary of the Senate) as two records, and they are almost certainly one person. If they are merged, keep this larger crop and drop the other; if they are not merged, this fills the 2008-09 record.
caption_quote: Bowling Green native Ann-Blair Thornton, the current Miss Kentucky and WKU student

name: Chris Mckenna
why: Sharp, well-lit, front-facing frame from a posed Herald group portrait; the only picture of him in the digitised Herald.
caption_quote: (from left to right) sophomore Alexandria Knipp, freshman Noah Stevens, senior Chris McKenna
identification: The caption gives an explicit left-to-right key for five people. Ordered by horizontal position the frame reads Knipp (front left, female), Stevens (back left, male, glasses), McKenna (front centre, male, dark suit), Alamri (back right, male), Shipp (front right, female). The three genders in the list match that order exactly, so the third name lands on the seated man in the centre. Herald spells the surname McKenna; the archive spells it Mckenna.

name: Austin Wingate
why: Sharp, well-lit, dignified three-quarter profile in a suit; the only photograph of him in the digitised Herald.
caption_quote: WKU graduate Austin Wingate, from Elizabethtown talks with junior Darius Fields
identification: Two men in frame. Three cues agree on the sharp foreground man at left: he is named first in a caption that runs left to right, he is the only one in focus and so the frame subject, and the caption has him doing the talking while he is the one mid-word. Darius Fields is the blurred man behind. That this is the SGA Austin Wingate rather than a namesake is supported by the Herald of 20 March 2012 (Vol. 87 No. 29), which lists Austin Wingate as one of three candidates for SGA president, so he was a student until 2012 and a WKU graduate by 2017.

name: Austin Bernard Wingate
why: Same frame as the 2010-11 Austin Wingate portrait. NOTE FOR THE EDITOR: years.json carries Austin Bernard Wingate (2008-09, member) and Austin Wingate (2010-11, Speaker of the Student Senate) as two records and they are almost certainly one man. If they are merged, keep one copy and drop this file; if they are not, this fills the 2008-09 record.
caption_quote: WKU graduate Austin Wingate, from Elizabethtown talks with junior Darius Fields
identification: See the 2010-11 Austin Wingate entry. Same photograph, same reasoning.

name: Chad Winston
why: Small but eyes-open and dignified: he is preaching, which is what the caption describes. A larger frame of him from the same photographers package that day (wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/02/466bda81854f135120483499fa0cebd4.jpg, 716x759, same grey suit, lavender shirt and purple tie, same church) carries no caption of its own and shows him with his eyes screwed shut comforting a weeping woman, so it is better resolved and worse as a portrait. The editor may prefer it.
caption_quote: Bowling Green senior Chad Winston leads a Bible study before preaching at Cedar Grove Baptist Church
identification: The caption names one person and describes one action. He is the only person standing, the only one at the lectern with an open book, and the only one in a suit; everyone else is seated in the pews. No ambiguity.

name: Elizabeth McGrew
why: The only photograph of her in any WKU source found; face is small and she is in motion, but it is lit, front-on enough to be recognisable, and it shows her at the SGA-sponsored garden she ran. NOTE FOR THE EDITOR: years.json carries Elizabeth McGrew (2013-14) and Beth McGrew (2014-15) as two records and they are one woman; Beth McGrew is not on this worklist, so only the 2013-14 record is filled here.
caption_quote: WKU grad student Beth McGrew helps direct volunteer efforts during the Earth Day Garden Party
identification: Five people in frame, one named, and the caption describes one action. She is the only person directing: pointing across the bed with a watering can in her other hand while the rest kneel and plant, and she is the only one wearing the gardens own Project Grow shirt. The Herald of 21 April 2014 settles it by giving her the job: it calls her Henderson graduate student Beth McGrew, coordinator of the community garden (wkuherald.com/40323/news/sga-and-office-of-sustainability-kick-off-earth-week). The coordinator is the person directing volunteers.

name: LaDarra Starkey
why: A studio headshot cut from the Phi Mu Delta Tau chapter composite for 2007-2008: front on, evenly lit, smiling, eyes open. Small only because eighty-four portraits share one 2997x2327 scan; not upscaled. This is the same route four portraits already in the archive came by (Katie Jeter, Jessica Sutton, Kristiana Garvey, Dajana Vasilijevic-Klingler).
identification: Her name is printed on the plate directly beneath her own oval, so no counting is needed. The archive's own record key agrees independently: TopSCHOLAR describes UA1C11/105/31 as '7th row l to r: Devin Roos, Brenda Sherlock, Kayla Smith, Katelyn Spralding, LaDarra Starkey, Kelli Stuntebeck ...', and she is the fifth oval in the bottom row, between Katelyn Spalding and Kelli Stuntebeck exactly as printed. A WKU student in 2007-08 named LaDarra Starkey and the LaDarra Starkey who sat in the SGA senate in 2008-09 are the same person on the same campus in consecutive years.
